title: ACAT Actuator Settings
description: Configuration for input devices (switches) in ACAT - keyboard, camera, BCI, external switches

actuatorSetting.description: Configuration for a single actuator (input device)

id.description: Unique identifier (GUID) for the actuator. Must be preserved during migration.

description.description: User-friendly description of the actuator. May contain HTML markup for help links.

enabled.description: Whether the actuator is currently enabled

imageFileName.description: Name of the image file representing the actuator (stored in theme folder)

switchSettings.description: List of switch configurations for this actuator

switchSetting.description: Configuration for a single switch belonging to an actuator

source.description: Switch source identifier (e.g., key combination, gesture code)

actuate.description: Whether the switch should trigger actions. If false, it only logs events.

command.description: Command verb associated with the switch. Use '@Trigger' for selection. May reference variables like @CmdActuatorToggleCalibrationWindow.

minHoldTime.description: Minimum hold time for the switch. If held for less, activation is ignored. May reference variable '@MinActuationHoldTime'.

beepFile.description: Optional audio file to play when switch is activated
